entities.name: Ján Havlík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ján Havlík was a Slovak Catholic seminarian with the Congregation of the Mission. He was beatified by Pope Francis in 2024 for his martyrdom under Communist rule in Czechoslovakia. His feast day is 12 February. He was dubbed "the martyr of faithfulness" by the Conference of Slovak Bishops.
